claim_quality_summary.claim_basis: Existing VM-264 claim-bearing evidence rows only.
claim_quality_summary.support_material_policy: Support-only, shaping-only, discovery-only, Commander/operator, precon support, architecture, synthesis, manual-fill, and quarantine material may appear only in bounded profile or review notes.
claim_quality_summary.evidence_quality: High for lifecycle, naming, metadata/query-only boundary, missing-color framing, and Witch-Maw boundary; medium for bounded Atraxa / Breed Lethality support texture and patient-growth framing; low or deferred for exact card facts, Commander legality, direct product/article grounding, rankings, cEDH claims, and Phyrexia-only collapse.
known_limitations: Direct Witch-Maw card facts remain Manual fill required.
Atraxa / Breed Lethality / Growth product grounding remains support-only unless stronger local capture is added.
Adjacent separators remain architecture guidance, not raw claim evidence.
Commander legality, recommendations, rankings, and metagame claims remain deferred.
WITCH is the Vox Mana expression/research label, while Growth is Commander 2016 support/display framing rather than a public alias or exclusive official name.
Long-form metaphysics, ritual cultivation symbolism, strategy, and comparative claims should stay conservative and bounded.
The three unmanaged Witch drafts remain discovery-only quarantine records and are not raw-claim evidence.
